claim: A user pool can send at most 50 email messages per day per AWS account with the default email configuration, and this quota is not adjustable; for a higher email delivery volume you configure the user pool to use your Amazon SES email configuration.
question: How many emails per day can Amazon Cognito send with its default email configuration?

values.display: use your Amazon SES email configuration

qualifiers.condition: default Cognito email feature only; Amazon SES configuration lifts it

evidence.quote: | Email messages sent daily per AWS account[2](#cognito-resource-quotas-email-note) | 50 | No | N/A |
For a higher email delivery volume, configure your user pool to use your Amazon SES email configuration.

note: Exam trap: email sign-up at scale needs Amazon SES.
